tools.name: calculate_safea_work_permit_points
tools.description: Evaluate foreign applicant eligibility across standard points, native English teacher (7-country passport + 120h TEFL), or WFOE entrepreneur tracks using official SAFEA rubric weights and Tier 1/2 salary bands.

tools.name: optimize_work_permit_score_deficit
tools.description: Diagnose exact point gaps below Category B (60) or Category A (85) thresholds and rank concrete SAFEA upgrade levers such as HSK certification, >=9-month service commitment, university ranking bonus, and salary restructuring.

tools.name: simulate_expat_iit_and_tax_refund
tools.description: Compare Option A fapiao-backed tax-exempt fringe benefits extended through 2027 (Circular [2023] No. 29) against Option B Tax App Special Additional Deductions across 7 statutory income tax brackets.

tools.name: calculate_job_transfer_runway_deadlines
tools.description: Compute statutory dates under PRC Labor Contract Law Articles 37 and 50 from a resignation date, pinpointing the 15-day release letter deadline, Day+20 filing cutoff, T-Visa expiry, and arbitration escalation steps.

tools.name: verify_country_apostille_and_legalization
tools.description: Look up document authentication requirements across 21 issuing jurisdictions to distinguish single-step domestic Hague Apostille from dual-step Chinese Embassy consular legalization, competent bureaus, and turnaround weeks.

tools.name: compare_municipal_work_permit_policies
tools.description: Inspect and compare municipal processing speeds, Greater Bay Area or Hainan FTP 15% income tax rebates, Category B age-65 exceptions, and designated Travel Healthcare Center locations across 7 Chinese hubs.

tools.name: evaluate_fast_track_and_no_degree_pathways
tools.description: Check statutory fast-track exemptions (6x local average wage by city, Top-100 postdoc, Fortune 500 executive, Top-100/Chinese Master recent graduate) to see if bachelor degree or 2-year experience rules are waived.

tools.name: generate_visa_execution_roadmap_and_arrival_kit
tools.description: Retrieve end-to-end procedural checklists for overseas Z-visa onboarding, in-country employer changes, X1/S1 status switches, 24h police accommodation rules, and authoritative policy guide briefings.
